errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.message: The app hit an unexpected error. Try again, and if it keeps happening, restart the app.

settings.title: Settings
settings.codeHint: Your partner signs in, then enters this code. It works for one person only.
settings.codeHint_friend: Your friend signs in, then enters this code. It works for one person only.
settings.shareMessage: Join me on Simul! Our invite code is {{code}}
settings.newCodeMessage: The current code will stop working. Use this if you shared it with the wrong person.
settings.signOutMessage: You can sign back in anytime.
settings.leaveMessage: Your personal habits and check-ins will be deleted. Shared habits stay with your partner.
settings.deleteAccountMessage: This permanently deletes your account and all of your data. This can't be undone.

auth.noPasswords: No passwords. We'll email you a sign-in link.
auth.linkSentTo: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. Open it on this phone.
auth.codeFallback: If your email has a code instead, enter it below.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Simul
onboarding.subtitle: Simul is for two. Start a household or join your partner's.
onboarding.subtitle_friend: Simul is for two. Start a household or join your friend's.
onboarding.createHint: You'll get an invite code to share.
onboarding.joinHint: Use the code from their Settings.
onboarding.photoPermissionBody: Enable photo access in Settings to set a profile picture.
onboarding.notifBody: We'll let you know about invites from your partner and, soon, habit reminders. You can change this anytime in Settings.
onboarding.notifBody_friend: We'll let you know about invites from your friend and, soon, habit reminders.
onboarding.kindHint_couple: Habits for two, as a couple.
onboarding.kindHint_friend: Habits with a friend, to keep each other going.
onboarding.joinKindNote: You'll use Simul with whoever invited you.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Something went wrong loading your data. Check your connection and try again.
errors.not_allowed: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.household_full: That household already has two people.
errors.invalid_code: That code isn't valid. Check it and try again.
errors.link_expired: That sign-in link expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.link_other_device: Open the sign-in link on the same phone where you entered your email, or request a new one here.

home.emptyBody: Add your first habit — for yourself, or one to do together.
home.emptyBody_friend: Add your first habit — for yourself, or one to do together.
home.emptyBodyReadOnly: No habits existed on this day.
home.restBody: Enjoy the day off. Your habits come back on their days.

mailbox.title: Mailbox
mailbox.emptyBody: When {{name}} invites you to a shared habit, it'll show up here for you to accept.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.bodyNone: Complete your first habit to earn one. Some badges stay hidden until you find them.
achievements.bodyProgress: {{count}} to go. A few are secret — keep going to reveal them.
achievements.secretBody: Keep going to reveal this one.

together-first.title: Better together
together-first.description: Finish a shared habit with your partner.
together-first.description_friend: Finish a shared habit with your friend.

inviter.title: Team player
inviter.description: Invite your partner to a shared habit.
inviter.description_friend: Invite your friend to a shared habit.

perfect-week.title: Perfect week
perfect-week.description: Every single day of a week, done together.
perfect-week.description_friend: Every single day of a week, done together.

comeback.title: The comeback
comeback.description: Came back after a few days away. Welcome back.

stats.title: Stats
stats.empty: Complete this habit to see your trend.

habit.name: Name
habit.deleteBody: "{{habit}}" and its history will be removed.
habit.deleteBodyShared: "{{habit}}" and its history will be removed for both you and {{name}}.
habit.inviteSentJoined: {{name}} will find "{{habit}}" in their mailbox. It shows as pending on your Home until they accept.
habit.inviteSentWaiting: "{{habit}}" will be waiting in your partner's mailbox as soon as they join with your invite code (Settings → Household).
habit.inviteSentWaiting_friend: "{{habit}}" will be waiting in your friend's mailbox as soon as they join with your invite code (Settings → Household).

proof.title: Proof of work
proof.hint: Attach a photo when you complete it. {{name}} confirms it before it counts.
proof.needsPartner: Available once someone joins to confirm the photos.

proof.captureMessage: This habit needs a photo so {{name}} can confirm it.
proof.permission: Allow camera access in Settings to take a photo.
proof.uploadError: Couldn't upload the photo. Try again.
proof.undoBody: The photo is deleted and the habit goes back to not done.

proofs.title: Proof
proofs.empty: No photos yet. They show up here when a habit gets completed.
proofs.rejectHint: Rejecting removes the completion so they can try again.
